style.styleTitle: Lights4fun Autumnal Wreath With Warm White Leds
style.toneOfVoice: Give your home a berry autumnal look. This 35cm Pre-Lit Berry Harvest Autumn Wreath adds a note of autumn to your home. It styles beautifully on walls and doors to create a homely ambiance. The berry harvest leaves embody the season and add a cheerful touch. Designed for effortless use, the 6-hour timer switches lights on automatically at the same time each evening and switches them off again automatically. Alternatively, you can choose the constant ‘on’ setting for a glow throughout the day. Enjoy the warm white shine without the worry of an open flame. Dimensions(mm): Height: Width: Depth: Supplied with Batteries. Battery Type: AA.
